cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(test_package CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# grpc/protobuf from the registry are component-rich CMake packages
# (cmake_find_mode=none): load their native configs first. FindgRPCAlt-style
# lookups (find_package(gRPC CONFIG)) resolve gRPCConfig.cmake, but the
# consumer config generated by CMakeDeps calls find_dependency(grpc) in
# lowercase — pre-set grpc_FOUND so that lookup is skipped, then load the
# real config for the imported targets.
find_package(gRPC CONFIG REQUIRED)
set(grpc_FOUND TRUE)
set(Protobuf_FOUND TRUE)
set(protobuf_FOUND TRUE)

find_package(ArrowFlight REQUIRED)
# All libarrow_flight components (arrow / arrow_compute / arrow_flight /
# arrow_flight_sql) are exported through the single ArrowFlightConfig.cmake
# generated by CMakeDeps — the component targets are namespaced
# Arrow::... / ArrowFlight::... / ArrowFlightSQL::...

add_executable(test_package test_package.cpp)
target_link_libraries(test_package PRIVATE ArrowFlight::arrow_flight_static ArrowFlightSQL::arrow_flight_sql_static)
